summary.text: Sean Stinnett is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 41 who has served since March 3, 2025, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Baltimore and state procurement and small-business official, he serves on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Sean Stinnett was born in Baltimore in October 1971 and graduated from the Baltimore School for the Arts in 1989, according to his General Assembly biography.
He earned an A.A. from Baltimore City Community College in 1995 and a B.S. from Coppin State University in 2006.

He was deputy director and then director of Baltimore Main Streets in the Mayor's Office of Small, Minority & Women Businesses from 2020 to 2023, worked at the Maryland Department of General Services from 2023 to 2025, and has been a program compliance administrator at the Maryland Department of Juvenile Services since 2025.
Ballotpedia lists Stinnett as appointed to the House on February 26, 2025.
He serves on the Judiciary Committee and is a Deputy Majority Whip in 2026.

His biography lists community roles including president of the West Arlington Community Association and president of the Maryland Muslim Council, and Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
